_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.signup. New-account registration form.

submit._use: Primary CTA on the signup form.

passwordStrength.label: Heading above the password-strength meter; pairs with the strength label rendered next to it (e.g. Strong, Weak).

alreadyHaveAccount._use: Sentence rendered before the inline link to /login at the bottom of the form. The link copy is provided separately as `signInLink`.

signInLink._use: Inline link that takes users from /signup to /login.
